See also: Transporte and transporté

French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tʁɑ̃s.pɔʁt/

Verb

[edit]

transporte

  1. inflection of transporter:
    1. first/third-person singular present indicative/subjunctive
    2. second-person singular imperative

Anagrams

[edit]
  • prosternât

Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tɾansˈpɔɾte/ [t̪ɾans̺ˈpɔɾ.t̪ɪ]
  • Rhymes: -ɔɾte
  • Hyphenation: trans‧por‧te

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from transportar.

Noun

[edit]

transporte m (plural transportes)

  1. action of transporting
  2. transit, transportation (system)

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

transporte

  1. inflection of transportar:
    1. first/third-person singular present subjunctive
    2. third-person singular imperative

Further reading

[edit]
  • “transporte”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026
  • “transporte”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃sˈpɔʁ.t͡ʃi/ [tɾɐ̃sˈpɔh.t͡ʃi]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃sˈpɔʁ.t͡ʃi/ [tɾɐ̃sˈpɔh.t͡ʃi]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃sˈpɔɾ.t͡ʃi/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃ʃˈpɔʁ.t͡ʃi/ [tɾɐ̃ʃˈpɔχ.t͡ʃi]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃sˈpɔɻ.t͡ʃi/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃sˈpɔʁ.te/ [tɾɐ̃sˈpɔh.te]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /tɾɐ̃ʃˈpɔɾ.tɨ/

  • Rhymes: -ɔʁt͡ʃi, -ɔɾtɨ
  • Hyphenation: trans‧por‧te

Etymology 1

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
transporte
Wikipedia pt

Deverbal from transportar (“to transport”).

Noun

[edit]

transporte m (plural transportes)

  1. transport (act of transporting)
    Synonyms: frete, transportamento
  2. (uncountable) transportation (conveyance of people and goods)
    Synonym: condução
  3. (military) transport (vehicle used to transport troops and equipment)
Derived terms
[edit]
  • transporte público
Related terms
[edit]
  • transportabilidade
  • transportação
  • transportado
  • transportador
  • transportadora
  • transportamento
  • transportar
  • transportável
  • transportista

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

transporte

  1. inflection of transportar:
    1. first/third-person singular present subjunctive
    2. third-person singular imperative

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tɾansˈpoɾte/ [t̪ɾãnsˈpoɾ.t̪e]
  • Rhymes: -oɾte
  • Syllabification: trans‧por‧te

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from transportar and transportarse.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • trasporte

Noun

[edit]

transporte m (plural transportes)

  1. transport, transportation
    Synonym: (Philippines) transportación
Derived terms
[edit]
  • medio de transporte
  • transporte público
Related terms
[edit]
  • transportar
Descendants
[edit]
  • → Tagalog: transporte

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

transporte

  1. inflection of transportar:
    1. first/third-person singular present subjunctive
    2. third-person singular imperative

Further reading

[edit]
  • “transporte”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish transporte.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /tɾansˈpoɾte/ [t̪ɾɐn̪sˈpoɾ.t̪ɛ]
  • Rhymes: -oɾte
  • Syllabification: trans‧por‧te

Noun

[edit]

transporte (Baybayin spelling ᜆ᜔ᜇᜈ᜔ᜐ᜔ᜉᜓᜇ᜔ᜆᜒ)

  1. (uncommon) transportation; transport
    Synonyms: transportasyon, paglululan, paghahatid, paglilipat
  2. (uncommon) transport (ship or airplane used to carry men and supplies)
